evidence.quote: it needs to do the full design

observations.why: Scarlet issues a binding instruction to hold the ruling back and require design and testing before implementation; rank-based command.

evidence.quote: You want to tightly control the unit of expand.

observations.why: Directive setting the boundary on expansion units; the speaker prescribes the design constraint from position.
Inclusive 'Let's' invites joint naming; the directive is softened into shared ownership of the label.
Sequencing command issued as a required order of operations.

evidence.quote: isn't our entire stance here that production isn't doing it right?

observations.why: Possessive 'our stance' and tag-question seek shared agreement on the position; we-ness carries the challenge.

evidence.quote: do this set with the big models

observations.why: Principal's directive assigning which models judge the set; rank-based allocation of the task, witnessed through the session's rendering.

evidence.quote: If you're using one amp of electricity, the circuit breaker is at 15 amps.

observations.why: Proportional analogy: caps should sit far above normal use and trip only on abnormal consumption; cost-proportion framing.

evidence.quote: Program spend $1.41 for the recall tests and $3.00 for the judged set.

observations.why: Cost figures stated for the two test phases, proportioning spend against output.

evidence.quote: is a generally known stupid thing to do

observations.why: Cost-benefit judgment against building a database: the cost of building one outweighs the value unless that is the goal.

evidence.quote: I'd really like us to far more take a standing

observations.why: Collective standard framed as a shared practice; the 'us' carries the reuse norm as a joint commitment.
Formal ruling act issuing binding consequences; rank-based decision enacted by declaration.
